name: Paris Games Week
blurb: France's biggest consumer video-game expo, held at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles each autumn.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'FROM OCTOBER 22TH TO OCTOBER 25TH 2026 PARIS EXPO / PORTE DE VERSAILLES' and 'IN 2026, PGW RETURNS FOR ITS 15TH EDITION'

notes: Consumer video-game trade expo organised around publisher/exhibitor booths (organiser SELL = Syndicat des Éditeurs de Logiciels de Loisirs) rather than an individual celebrity-guest program; no 'guests'/'invités' page exists on the official site, so guests is 'none'.
